name: Yidian Zhi Ge
source:
"That is the lingering echo from the golden age...
To preserve the ember of human civilization in the apocalypse,
The Muse Corporation created an isolated island,
Forging false prosperity to craft a tranquility that will never return,
Attempting to ensure the continuity of human civilization on unfamiliar soil."

"Punishing Gray Raven" female-oriented doujin game — "Ballad of Eden," stay tuned.
Thanks to every member of the BOE production team for their hard work.

machine translated by [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Y341167Nk/]official site[/url]

A fangame of [url=https://pns.kurogame.com/]Punishing Gray Raven[/url].
